source: Partner's Google Drive folder '3D models / 86th St ADA 6 train', taken on an iPhone 16 on 2026-11-26 and handed over 2026-11-27
prepared: Photos cut to 2400 px on the long side and videos to 720p H.264 at 1.8 Mbit/s, faces blurred with Apple Vision face and body detection, metadata (including the phone's GPS) dropped. The sensor log is the original CSVs in a tar.xz. NaviLens codes were read with the reader from pull request 261 with its white-frame check at 50% (see docs/STATION_MEDIA.md).
